reviews.author: Marc S
reviews.text: I’ve brought my BMW to Roger’s Repair Shop several times, and every experience has been exceptional. Roger himself is not only knowledgeable but remarkably meticulous, something I truly value. He’s reasonable, accommodating, and above all, honest. Despite how busy the shop is, the quality of their work never wavers. They take the time to do things right, and it shows. I’ll continue trusting all my vehicles to Roger’s, and I recommend this garage without hesitation. Outstanding service, skilled workmanship, and genuine integrity, Roger’s Repair Shop delivers it all.

reviews.author: Francisco Dejesus
reviews.text: have used Rogers Auto Repair several times and they are detailed in there work and explains all issues affecting the car. I feel the shop is a rare find, most auto repair shops try to extort more monies than needed. i recommend.
